text:
Chiara Bianchi: Hey everyone :wave: I’m Chiara, starting today on the Ops team! Mostly infra + deployment reliability. Quick Q — who should I ping about VPN access and access to the staging cluster?
Alex Kim: Welcome Chiara! :tada: Ping me for VPN. Also add yourself to the #eng-infra channel, you’ll get the onboarding runbook there.
Chiara Bianchi: Thanks Alex — do I need to request anything from IT or is it automatic with my SSO?
onboarding-bot: Hi Chiara — VPN invite sent to your email. Follow the steps at https://intranet.redwood/vpn-setup. If you don’t see it in 10m, reply here.
Devon Park: Hi Chiara — for staging creds, file a ticket in the internal portal under ‘env access’ and tag me. Also, for git access run:
```
git config --global user.name "Chiara Bianchi"
git config --global user.email "chiara@redwood.dev"
```
Jess Rivera: Welcome! We usually pair new hires with a buddy — mine last week was super helpful. My calendar is open if you want a 30m sync to walk through deploy workflows :coffee: 
Chiara Bianchi: That’d be great, thanks Jess. One fun fact: I make challah every weekend 🥖. Also allergic to cilantro, so apologies for any green-sauce overshares.
Alex Kim: Love the challah :heart_eyes: We’ll add you to the weekly ops standup recurrences. If you need swag or stickers, ping #people-ops and they’ll drop by a sticker pack.
Chiara Bianchi: Got it, thanks everyone — I’ll try the VPN steps now and follow up if anything breaks. :pray:
